fusions.name: Rehearsed Roll
fusions.desc: You roll in place, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the enemy [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Opening Move
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every tenth of health the target still has, up to 40%.

fusions.name: From the Top
fusions.desc: You slip 2 tiles back and clear the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Textbook Ambush
fusions.desc: Your strikes have 30% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet. After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike has 35% more critical chance.
